master_script.hook: Gym owners, kya aapka ad 15 second mein dhyaan khinchta hai?

hooks.text: Bohot kam brands apne ads mein ye ek cheez karte hain…
Kaash mujhe ads ke baare mein ye pehle pata hota…
Kabhi dhyan diya hai, ads mein log pehle kya dekhte hain…
Do second mein grahak aapka ad scroll kar deta hai…
Cafe ki static photo ad ko grahak do second mein scroll kar deta…
Cafe ki static photo ad grahak do second mein scroll kar deta hai, kyunki motion nahi hota.

beats.line: Gym owners, kya aapka ad 15 second mein dhyaan khinchta hai?
beats.visual: Gym interior with trainer, phone showing 15‑second timer and stopwatch overlay.

beats.line: WhatsApp pe enquiry ka reply aap miss kar rahe hain, koi follow‑up nahi milta.
beats.visual: Phone screen with WhatsApp chat, unread message bubble highlighted.

beats.line: Par ads mein pehle kya dikhaya jaye, ye decide nahi hota…
beats.visual: Blurred text on a phone screen with a question mark.

beats.line: Enquiry reply nahi aata? Offer chunein, taaki aap 15‑second ad bana saken.
beats.visual: Phone screen shows missed WhatsApp notification, then a 15‑second animated ad thumbnail appears.

beats.line: Genyad ke mutabik, 15‑second ad mein paanch core beats hote hain, zaroori.
beats.visual: Genyad logo, timeline of 15‑second ad with icons for hook, problem, offer, proof, ask

beats.line: Static photo se grahak chala jata, lekin chhota ad ungli rok leta hai.
beats.visual: Split screen: a still photo is ignored, then an animated ad stops the thumb.

beats.line: Comment ADS, taaki main DM mein checklist bhejun aur aap samajh saken. Poora breakdown aaj ke carousel mein hai.
beats.visual: Anmol points to comment box, then shows DM screen with checklist.

master_script.cta: Comment ADS, taaki main DM mein checklist bhejun aur aap samajh saken. Poora breakdown aaj ke carousel mein hai.
master_script.linkedin_english: Small business owners often lose attention with static image ads on Instagram and Facebook. A short animated ad can fit a complete message in 15 seconds, with a hook, problem, offer, proof, and ask. Comment ADS and I will send you a one-page checklist for what your short ad should show, so a customer understands your business.
